channel.title: Internet and data: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the internet and data sector.

item.title: Kinx: KINX reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 44.5bn and operating profit of KRW 9.5bn, up 12.83% and 53.54% year on year.
Kinx: KINX reported Q3 2026 preliminary revenue of KRW 31.8bn and operating profit of KRW 8.9bn, up 77.21% year on year.
ktis: KTis reported Q3 2026 preliminary revenue of KRW 165.2bn and operating profit of KRW 9.2bn, both up year on year.
